title: Apple regains top spot as world’s most valuable company
facts: Apple surpassed Nvidia to become the world’s most valuable company on July 17, 2026.
Nvidia's market valuation fell by 3.5 percent to $4.86 trillion.
Nvidia previously surpassed the $5 trillion market valuation mark in October.
Apple unveiled an updated version of its personal assistant named Siri AI last month.
Michael Monaghan is the founder of Founder ETFs.
Apple is scheduled to release its third-quarter earnings on July 30.
Apple executives previously forecast quarterly sales growth of 14 percent to 17 percent.
Apple CEO Tim Cook is scheduled to step down and hand over leadership to John Ternus in September.
John Ternus has served as Apple’s head of hardware engineering since 2021.
Semiconductor competitor Micron surpassed a $1 trillion market valuation in May.
South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix joined the Nasdaq stock exchange in May.
Benjamin Hall serves as vice president of alpha research at Segal Marco Advisors.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq index declined by 1.6 percent in midday trading on July 17, 2026.
The S&P 500 index fell by 0.9 percent on July 17, 2026.
